newsitem.title: POLAND: Amerbank hopes to find investor by end-96.
newsitem.headline: Amerbank hopes to find investor by end-96.

text.p: Polish Bank Amerykanski w Polsce Amerbank SA (Amerbank) expects to find a strategic investor who would take a minority stake in the bank by the end of the year, the bank's deputy president said.
"We should be able to find a minority strategic investor by the end of the year ... we would like a financial institution, either domestic or foreign," Wlodzimierz Paszkowski told Reuters.
Paszkowski said that the details of the share transaction and the size of the stake would be decided after the investor was chosen.
The bank's goal was to acquire a stable, long-term investor with the know-how Amerbank needs.
